steps.en: The work order list is already on screen
steps.id: Daftar work order sudah tampil di layar
steps.why_en: No work order list can be shown at all.
steps.why_id: Daftar work order tidak bisa ditampilkan sama sekali.

steps.en: Officer removes a record and gives a reason
steps.id: Officer menghapus record dan mengisi alasan
steps.why_en: There is no remove action and no reason field.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aksi hapus dan tidak ada isian alasan.

steps.en: Officer adds a record and gives a reason
steps.id: Officer menambah record dan mengisi alasan
steps.why_en: There is no add action and no reason field.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aksi tambah dan tidak ada isian alasan.

steps.en: Changes and reasons are saved with the work order
steps.id: Perubahan dan alasan tersimpan bersama work order
steps.why_en: Nothing stores work order amendments or reasons.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada penyimpanan perubahan atau alasan work order.
